subject: Artist transport, coaches, security and site facilities for Field Day | Sourced.
text:
Hi Field Day team,

I'm Benji, founder of Sourced., a London sourcing company for festivals, events and productions. Festival season planning starts early, so I wanted to introduce what we can supply from one brief, with one quote:

- Artist and guest transport: VIP Sprinters, Maybach-style V-Classes, chauffeur cars and private jets
- Crew and guest shuttles: executive coaches and 16-seat Sprinters
- SIA-licensed close protection for headliners, plus site and backstage security
- Backstage facilities: dressing room and make-up trailers, luxury and standard toilets, generators and green rooms
- Catering for artists and crew, including special diets

If any of that is on your list for next season, I'd love to quote. You can see more at www.wearesourced.co.uk.
